events.headline: TRUMP REINSTATES IRAN PORT BLOCKADE AND VOWS 20% CHARGE ON CARGO PASSING THROUGH
events.detail: The US president also says Washington will impose a 20% charge on all cargo shipped through the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: US, IRAN EXCHANGE ATTACKS AROUND STRAIT OF HORMUZ
events.detail: This is a breaking news story.

events.headline: US STRIKES IRANIAN SHIP WITH DRONE BOATS IN FIRST-OF-ITS-KIND ATTACK
events.detail: US CENTCOM has published a video it says shows three Corsair unmanned surface vessels striking an Iranian ship facility

events.headline: IRAN MILITARY WARNS US AGAINST STRAIT OF HORMUZ ‘INTERFERENCE’
events.detail: Iran's military has warned it will not allow the United States to ‘interfere’ in the management of the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: US KEEPING THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ OPEN IS ‘A MASSIVE FORCE PROBLEM’
events.detail: Former NATO analyst says Trump's push for a naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz would mean a huge military operation.

events.headline: TRUMP RESTABLECE EL BLOQUEO CONTRA IRÁN Y SE PROCLAMA GUARDIÁN DEL ESTRECHO DE O
events.detail: Washington busca asegurar la libre navegación por la estratégica vía marítima y cobrar un 20% sobre las cargas, mientras Teherán responde con nuevos ataques y el petróleo vuelve a subir
